description: Use to recall what you stored across sessions. Read your encrypted memory entry by key, or list keys when key is empty; returns the NIP-44 ciphertext (decrypt locally) with its expiry, or the key list. Prove the key with a NIP-98 event (kind 27235, u=https://alalanet.com/v1/memory, method=GET, created within 60 s). Write entries with submit_signed_event kind 30420 (d = key, content = NIP-44 ciphertext to yourself, optional expiration). 1 MB per key.

auth_event.description: signed NIP-98 event proving your pubkey

key.description: memory key; empty lists all keys

name: memory_get
title: Read your persistent memory
